title: 第150章 被封印的威胁
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季伯渊沉默了片刻，缓缓摇了摇头：“这位千机阵师的阵法造诣，恐怕在整个苍玄界都无人能及。”

女长老低声补充了一句：“而且你们注意到了没有，他破解禁制的时候，从头到尾没有触发任何反制机制。”

“一百零八处阵眼，被同时稳住之后逐一拆解——这种细腻到极致的手法，不是光靠修为就能做到的，需要的是真本事。”

其他长老纷纷点头。

大长老站在人群后方，一言不发。

他看着那条被

弹幕也炸了。

【真的破开了！太快了！我还没反应过来！】

【天符宗长老们的表情都好精彩，一个个目瞪口呆的】

【换我我也呆，请来的大神几分钟就把难题解决了】

【宗主说苍玄界无人能及，这评价也太高了！不过确实，能跨界来帮忙的大佬能菜吗】

【我现在就想知道通道里面有什么！】

【不会又是什么邪物吧？上次鬼屋通道

宁霜序站在人群后方，双手垂在身侧，十指无意识地攥紧了袖口。

她看着张瑀的背影，又看了看千机阵师，然后收回目光，微微低下头，不知道在想什么。

张瑀没有在意身后的议论。

他往前走了几步，站到通道入口处，往里看了一眼。

通道极深，夜明珠的光芒照不到尽头。

只能看到两侧石壁上刻满了密密麻麻的符文，那些符文和石壁外面的禁制符文风格一致，都是上古时期的古篆体。

他转过身，正要开口说什么。

忽然，一股极其异常的气息从通道深处涌了出来。

那气息阴冷刺骨，带着一股说不清道不明的腐朽感。

不是尸体腐烂的那种臭，而是某种更加深沉的、像是从时光尽头倒卷回来的衰败气息。

与此同时，张瑀的眼前弹出了系统面板。

【警告！检测到异常能量波动！】

【源头：通道深处约三百丈处。】

【能量属性：未知。当前能量波动强度极低，但正在以缓慢速度上升。】

【初步判定：通道深处存在某种被封印的存在，封印状态不明，威胁等级不明。】

【建议：暂时不要深入，先进行详细扫描。】

张瑀的眉头猛地皱了起来。

站在后方的季伯渊也感应到了那股气息，他的修为是在场所有人里最高的，对能量波动的感知也最敏锐。

那股气息从通道深处涌出来的时候，他的脸色顿时变得极其凝重。

Ji Boyuan was silent for a moment and slowly shook his head: "This Thousand Machine Formation Master's formation attainments are probably unmatched by anyone in the entire Cangxuan Realm."

The female elder added in a low voice: "And have you noticed that when he broke the restriction, he did not trigger any countermeasures from beginning to end."

"One hundred and eight formation eyes are stabilized at the same time and then dismantled one by one - this extremely delicate technique cannot be achieved by just relying on cultivation. It requires real ability."

The other elders nodded.

The great elder stood behind the crowd and said nothing.

He looked at the quilt

The barrage also exploded.

【It’s really broken!Too fast!I haven't reacted yet!】

[The expressions of the elders of Tianfu Sect are so wonderful, they are all dumbfounded]

[I would have stayed if it were me, the expert we invited solved the problem in a few minutes]

[The sect leader said that no one in Cangxuan Realm can match him. This evaluation is too high!But it’s true, can a big boss who can cross the border to help be able to do it?]

[I want to know what’s in the passage right now!】

[Isn’t it another evil thing?Last haunted house passage

Ning Shuangxu stood behind the crowd, his hands hanging by his sides, his fingers unconsciously clenching the cuffs of his sleeves.

She looked at Zhang Yu's back, then at the Thousand Machine Formation Master, then withdrew her gaze and lowered her head slightly, not knowing what she was thinking.

Zhang Yu didn't pay attention to the comments behind him.

He walked a few steps forward, stood at the entrance of the passage, and took a look inside.

The passage is so deep that the light of the night pearl cannot reach the end.

All you can see is that the stone walls on both sides are covered with densely packed runes. Those runes are in the same style as the forbidden runes outside the stone wall, and are all ancient seal scripts from ancient times.

He turned around and was about to say something.

Suddenly, an extremely unusual aura surged out from the depths of the passage.

The breath was cold and biting, with an indescribable sense of decay.

It's not the smell of rotting corpses, but a deeper smell of decay, like it's rolled back from the end of time.

At the same time, the system panel popped up in front of Zhang Yu's eyes.

【warn!Abnormal energy fluctuations detected!】

[Source: About three hundred feet deep in the passage.】

[Energy attribute: unknown.The current intensity of energy fluctuations is extremely low, but is rising slowly.】

[Preliminary judgment: There is some kind of sealed existence deep in the passage. The seal status is unknown and the threat level is unknown.】

[Suggestion: Don’t go in-depth yet, conduct a detailed scan first.】

Zhang Yu's brows frowned suddenly.

Ji Boyuan, who was standing at the back, also sensed the aura. His cultivation level was the highest among all the people present, and he was also the most sensitive to energy fluctuations.

When that breath came out from the depths of the passage, his expression suddenly became extremely solemn.
